description.value:
You lift three piles of rubble or debris from the ground to interpose between yourself and your foes for the duration. While three piles remain you have three-quarters cover, while two remain you have half cover, and while only one remains you have one-quarter cover; the piles never impede your own attacks.

When you cast this power, and again as an action on a later turn, you can direct up to two piles to attack up to two creatures you can see within 30 feet, making a ranged force attack roll for each. A pile that hits deals 2d6 kinetic plus 1d10 force damage, and is destroyed whether it hits or misses.

When cast using a force slot of 4th level or higher, the power creates one additional pile for each slot level above 3rd.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Universal Powers, Level 3
